verification_report.summary:
All five proof items were verified in textual order and are correct under the exact supplied internal premises. The conclusions hold for an arbitrary smooth big real theta with BMP and positive lower model-reference volume.

The stretching lemma establishes envelope existence before applying contact. Domination by one positive Hermitian background Omega and polarization bound every binomial mixed mass by 2^n v_+(Omega), uniformly even for unbounded potentials. This justifies the n2^nK(b-1) error and the tail contradiction. Convex interpolation, positive-current addition in scaled big backgrounds, homogeneity and ordinary-type monotonicity prove the upper-volume limit. Combining a genuine stretching with a strict potential supplied by bigness proves the strict barrier.

The cross-class rooftop has the explicit genuine competitor k_a. Same-class stretching is applied only to z and V_theta in E_V, whose reference has positive lower volume by monotonicity from phi. The upper-volume squeeze proves that the rooftop belongs to E_phi; constant normalization and upward stability handle arbitrary z.

For projection, p_0 supplies existence and capacity convergence, while p_C<=phi+sup_X z gives the uniform singularity bound required for the limit to remain in E_phi. Contact splitting assigns ties correctly, the phi-contact tail tends to zero, and both weighted lower-semicontinuity applications satisfy the supplied hypotheses. They establish measure domination and support on {Q=z}.

The minimal-reference existence theorem applies because lowerVol_theta(V_theta)>=ell>0. Projection then gives the finite supersolution measure e^(-Q)mu_Q<=nu; it is nonzero since mu_Q(X)>=ell. Polar-set conventions are legitimate throughout.

The attributions to [XL26 Propositions 3.1 and 3.3](https://arxiv.org/html/2601.13446v1) were confirmed against the official text and archive. Its stronger global metric assumptions are not imported: the submitted reconstruction independently supplies the required arguments. No semipositivity, closedness, separate global PVP, or arbitrary-model existence theorem is inserted.
